notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Fixing small visual issues and stage 51
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Just released a patch to fix a few things:

If a person kissed when blinking, they'd open their eyes after kiss and it'd look weird
In stage 51 if you opened a door and got hit by Imp at the same time, the door would bug (not be able to move)


That's it, just a couple simple fixes. Hope you guys are liking the game! :D

notes.title: We'll release this friday, July 22th!
notes.notes:
Hello friends! We're happy to announce Cupid Kiss will release this friday, July 22th!

[previewyoutube=VQEEJNDF-Os;full][/previewyoutube]

Cupid Kiss is a cute puzzle game where cupid Aelia needs to bring couples together for them to kiss! 💖💖
The people move in small blocks, inspired by those sliding puzzles you played as a kid. But it won't be easy, as her rival Morgan has called her Imp friends and other obstacles to stand in the couples' way!

The game has been a big success in live events we have showed it and I hope you'll love it too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1954020/Cupid_Kiss/?beta=0

A big hug from everybody at Supernova Games and please add it to your wishlist! ✨✨✨

Kisses, Renan
